<reason>CON won by isolating additionality: relabeling buyer does not create physical savings, curtailment needs demand/storage/upgrades, and retail spread must still pay capacity/balancing/backup+platform. PRO never proved net surplus after full cost recovery and never resolved the regulatory symmetry - if regulators can police fair P2P wires they can require fair export/midday tariffs - leaving the trading-vs-tariffs comparison in CON's favor.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A's Rebuttal 1/2 symmetry plus double-counting charge: already-exported power already avoids distant costs, curtailed power is not freed by a contract, and the same behavior can be rewarded by time-varying tariffs, which B's toll-road/value-discovery reply asserted but did not substantiate.</best_rebuttal>
